comparability_limitations: Validation reused historically; not blind validation or hidden-test evidence.

Per-adapter inherited generation defaults or PEFT behaviour cannot be ruled out without effective config evidence; avoid strict causal single-variable claims.
Paired metric wins/losses and format flags are not human quality wins/losses.
